# Current UTC time (time.now)

## categories

[
  "time"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "id": "basic",
    "input": {},
    "title": "Basic invocation in an empty workspace"
  }
]

## description

Returns an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with second precision. This is the host wall clock, not elapsed time or the supervisor deadline.
